title: The existence criterion of holomorphic discs for higher $A_\infty$ operations via minimal discs
summary: The main theorem of the paper provides an existence criterion of holomorphic discs for higher $A_\infty$ operations. The key step is to show that if a minimal disc in a Kähler manifold with boundary in a sequence of Lagrangian submanifolds intersecting transversely such that its partial Maslov indices are either all no less than $1$ or all no larger than $-1$, then there is a holomorphic disc with the same image as this minimal disc. As a by-product, we show that all minimal discs in $\C\mathrm{P}^m$ with boundary on $\R\mathrm{P}^m$ are holomorphic.
